svg.title: Entrance / exit gate controller and LPR interface
svg.text: LARP / TEAM CIRCUIT COMPLETION / 08
Entrance / exit gate controller and LPR interface
One reference controller per lane. Use the gate manufacturer's local safety controller; do not power a barrier motor from ESP32 pins.
LPR camera / simulated plate source
PoE CAT6 -> managed switch -> central API
Central resolves owner / approved visitor
Demo: plate entry form, not camera OCR
Real camera event API and credentials pending
Lane ESP32 + Ethernet
Same DevKit / W5500 reference as Sheet 02
SPI18/23/19; CS27; RESET21; INT22
OPEN request -> GPIO25
CLOSE request -> GPIO26
Commands require short expiry + replay
checks
Watchdog must not replay motion on boot
Central network
Two normally-open dry contacts
GPIO25/26 -> 3.3V-compatible relay drivers
Active-HIGH drivers; inputs 10k to 0V
Driver supply and flyback per module
NO1 -> vendor OPEN input; COM1 -> input COM
NO2 -> vendor CLOSE input; COM2 -> input COM
Contacts rated for vendor control circuit
No mains or motor power on relay contact plan
Logic only
Vendor barrier safety controller
OPEN / CLOSE pulses per vendor manual
Controls motor, brakes and travel limits
Safety beam / vehicle loops wired locally
Hardwired STOP per vendor safety design
Controller decides movement / hold-open
No automatic close from stale central data
Isolated contact requests
Isolated / conditioned status inputs
UP limit -> GPIO32; DOWN limit -> GPIO33
Beam healthy / clear -> GPIO34
Vehicle loop clear -> GPIO35
Local stop healthy -> GPIO36
External 10k pull-ups at 3V3 where applicable
24V vendor outputs need isolated interfaces
Input-only pins have no internal pull-ups
Broken or stale status blocks unsafe requests
Observed feedback
Vendor status -> conditioned inputs -> GPIO
Lane-specific interlocks and acceptance
Ceiling bay occupancy is NOT a gate safety beam. Validate lane sensors, passage, limits and stop independently.
Duplicate IDs, power loss, reboot, occupied beam and expired requests must not produce unexpected closure.
Existing Wokwi entry/exit servos visualize motion; they do not validate this real gate relay interface.
Gate power and emergency release follow the vendor installation manual. Confirm dry-contact voltage, pulse timing and status availability before wiring.
BENCH / MODULE REFERENCE - not a certified safety circuit or fabrication-ready PCB. See wiring schedule and design notes.
GPIO maps: ESP32-WROOM-32E DevKitC. The team WT32-ETH01 requires its own pin-map review. Motor current and field safety remain unverified.
